grid_axes.note: Principal axes of the existing first-web quad grid, from the rest-pose local edge-direction histogram. Read as layout context only.

displacement_vs_grid.note: How the local deformation field is oriented relative to the existing quad-grid axes. Large off-axis angle means the grid does not carry the motion along its own lines.

resolution.note: Deformation amplitude expressed in grid cells. Values well above 1 mean a single quad must absorb motion larger than its own size.
